buildNotes: T409 only. This PR does not spawn props or edit TerrainGen.
Streamed Models only. No new Remotes. Reuse MeshIds.
Wood lots stay under MaxWoodPartsServer. Counts of big, mid and small props stay odd.
Props sit at least 2 studs off the road bed. The bed stays RoadGravel through a belt.
Biome accent is tiny Neon on the apron only. No Neon posts. No Plastic studs.
No gondola. No ring fill. Camps do not sell.

knownOverlap.note: Frostpeak and Skyroot Highlands are both ground and both locked. Their discs overlap. Connor decides before T409 whether one shrinks or the shoulder is shared.

redo.note: T409+ replaces the live RingRoad. The valley plan has no ring. Do not silent-delete it in this PR.
redo.title: Ring road

redo.note: T409+ replaces the peak-to-caldera bore with a surface road. Do not silent-delete the live tunnel.
redo.title: Truck tunnel

removals.reason: Town station at the live gondola spot. Cloud access is the trunk lift, so the station has no job. Not on the MustKeep list.
removals.title: Gondola station

removals.reason: GondolaService builds a cabin tagged GondolaCabin for the ride. No ride, no cabin. It has no fixed plot.
removals.title: Gondola cabin

removals.reason: The cable runs from the town station to the live sky disc. The overview draws no cable. The trunk lift replaces the ride.
removals.title: Gondola cable

removals.reason: BuildingArt.SkyTurnstile is the Gondola Pass gate. MapBuilder does not place it. It should not be built for a ride that is leaving.
removals.title: Gondola turnstile

removals.reason: The isle CloudChute and its flume sit on the live sky disc. The trunk lift has its own log chute. The Sky Bin stays until that chute exists.
removals.title: Cloud chute

removals.reason: The court stands on the south meadow. The forge belongs on the clouds. KeeperSpot, TemperSpot and the four relic sockets are MustKeep: they move with the forge, they do not vanish.
removals.title: Ground Sky Forge court

removals.reason: The live sky disc floats in the east, reached by the gondola. The highlands are the north summit, the switchback, and the trunk lift. Lumenwood moves. The gondola top station and the root bridges do not.
removals.title: Floating isles with no road summit

removals.reason: WORLD_DESIGN retires the bloom. ForestService still sets SkyrootBloom and it still doubles figure chances, so it is not dead. Leave the clock until Connor says to remove it. The pin is the old gondola top, not the new summit.
removals.title: Skyroot Bloom clock

removals.reason: It stands just west of the ground court, telescope toward town. If the court goes, this may still be a deliberate view. Connor decides. It is not deleted here.
removals.title: Meadow lookout beside the court
